description: Is this firm on the ESMA MiCA register (CASP, e-money token issuer, white paper, or non-compliant warning list)? Free: look up a firm in the ESMA interim MiCA register by name (exact or fuzzy) or LEI, optionally narrowed by country. Returns match_quality, an ambiguous flag, candidate records with status, competent authority and source URL, plus ESMA attribution and register links. Absence from the register is not clearance. 60 calls/min per client.

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country / home member state filter for name matches
